The '''''Bulton Cruises''''' was a [[Ferryboat liner]] that was present at [[Camen Spaceport]] when the [[Hurrim]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Merte]]'', stolen by two members of [[Dunari]]'s coalition, escaped the Hurrim's asteroid base under heavy pursuit of [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class starfighters]]. [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] sent a strike force of two [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] to cover the retreat until the shuttle reached hyperspace. Her cargo contained tourists.
